@realm:     Essence

@category:  Base
@class:     Mana Molder

 8 | Combination I | 2 mana servants | varies | 10' | U

10 | Carrier | - | 5 min/lvl | 10' | E
11 | Climber | - | 5 min/lvl | 10' | E
12 | Scribe | - | 5 min/lvl | 10' | E
13 | Basher | - | 5 min/lvl | 10' | E
14 | Sound Observer | - | 5 min/lvl | 10' | E
15 | Mount II | - | 5 min/lvl | 10' | E
16 | Combination II | 2 mana servants | varies | 10' | U
17 | Visual Observer | - | 5 min/lvl | 10' | E
18 | Tunneler | - | 5 min/lvl | 10' | E
19 | Combination III | 3 mana servants | varies | 10' | U
20 | Flier | - | 5 min/lvl | 10' | E
30 | Observer True | - | 5 min/lvl | 10' | E
50 | Multi-Servant | - | 5 min/lvl | 10' | E

# Descriptions
@@ 1
The Binder is a circular band 3'' wide and 1' in diameter. It can contract to
whatever size the caster desires to hold two objects together. It can release
and contract again during the duration. The Strength of this bond is such that
is would normally require a hard maneuver (modified by triple Strength) to
break it. This can be used to bind wounds and (though the caster must make a
successfully First Aid maneuver to place the binding correctly) reducing
bleeding by up to 2 hits per round.
@@ 2
The Holder will hold onto anything the caster gives him for the duration of
the spell. The Holder may not move from the spot where it was created. The
object it is holding is fixed to the spot very tightly and it would normally
take a Very Hard maneuver (modified by triple Strength) to dislodge it. The
Holder can grip an object very tightly if necessary, but will never grip hard
enough to break the object.
@@ 3
The Alarm servant cannot move by itself, but can be moved by others. At the
time of casting, the caster designates a range and a number of targets up to
his level. If anyone other than the caster or designated targets come within
10' of the binder, the Alarm servant will begin a very loud wailing noise.
@@ 4
The Digger can move 1 cubic foot of earth per minute. Materials harder than
packed soil is beyond its ability. If digging straight down, the hole must be
at least 3 feet in diameter. If a Digger digs below 5 feet deep, progress will
be slowed by half unless another means is used to clear excess dirt from
around the hole.
@@ 5
The Doer can perform one simple repetitive action designated at the time of
casting. The Doer cannot move by itself, but can be moved by others. The
action it performs can involve only one tool and most assembly is beyond its
ability. The GM should use his own judgment to decide which task are simple
enough (turning a spinning wheel, grinding flour, chopping a tree, etc. are
probably simple enough).
@@ 6
The mount will carry one person (up to 250 lb.) on its back for the duration
of the spell. It can Be Ordered to Stop or turn, But it is not exceptionally
maneuverable. Otherwise, it will move at a constant rate of 70'per round and
can climb hills as steep as 45°. It is unaffected by poor footing (sand,
gravel, swampy ground) as long as the surface can support its weight and the
weight of its passenger.
@@ 7
The Swimmer consists of two barrel- shaped air bladders and two feet shaped
like flippers. it can swim on the surface of most liquids at a rate of 20'per
round (in a straight line). It can pull a weight of up to 100 pounds behind it
if a rope is attached, but this will half its rate.
@@ 8
Caster may combine two existing servants, created by lower level spells on
this list, into one servant that will be suitable for both tasks. This spell
will end then either of the servants is dispelled or when the first servant's
duration runs out.
@@ 9
The mover can pick up any single object (that weighs no more than 100 pounds)
and move it up to 100 feet away. If the caster desires, the Mover will
continue to do this with other similar objects until they are all moved to the
new location. The mover can Stack the objects in any fashion they are normally
stackable.
@@ 10
The Carrier is shaped like a big turtle with a flat back. It can carry up to
100 pounds per level of the caster (moving at a rate of up to 40'per round).
It is 5 feet wide by 9 feet long by 2 feet high. The carrier can negotiate
most terrain in the manner as the mount I spell. This spell makes no provision
for loading the cargo onto the carrier.
@@ 11
The Climber can move on any solid surface that the caster desires at a rate of
50' per round so long as the surface will support the weight of the Climber.
The Climber can even move across a ceiling, so long as the ceiling surface can
hold the weight of the climber (stone or wood should be no problem; plaster
might).
@@ 12
The scribe can copy any writing or drawing the caster puts before it as long
as it is provided with a writing instrument, ink and a suitable surface on
which to copy the writing or drawing. The scribe will copy one 10'' x 10''
area per minute. This Essence servant is non locomotive, but may be carried by
someone else.
@@ 13
The caster can instruct the Basher to destroy any non-living material within
100'. The Basher will move to and begin ''bashing'' the designated material,
inflicting 3d10 structural damage to it every round. The basher is extremely
limited in its ability to track a moving object and it cannot for example
attack the armor someone is wearing.
@@ 14
The observer will record all sounds within 20'of the servant for a duration
designated by the caster at the time of casting. Caster may play back the
recorded sounds at anytime within the spell's duration. Recorded sound must be
played from start to finish with no modifications or pauses within the
recording.
@@ 15
As Mount I. except the rate is 140' per round, the weight limit is 500 pounds,
and the mount is maneuverable enough to use in combat.
@@ 16
As Combination I, except will work on any servants created up to the level of
this spells.
@@ 17
As Sound Observer, except records a visual impression of all sights within
20'of the servant. When Played back the image is displayed inside of the
servant. The caster may rotate the servant to view the full area within the
radius of effect.
@@ 18
Creates a Tunneler servant. The Tunneler can burrow through materials as hard
as granite at the rate of 2 cubic feet per minute. The material moved by this
servant is ground into fine sand.
@@ 19
As Combination I, except will work on any created servants.
@@ 20
Creates a Flier servant. The flier can fly at a rate of up to 200'per round.
It has two gripping appendages and can carry up two objects as long as the
total weight is not over 50 pounds.
@@ 30
As sound Observer, except records all sounds, visual image, and any other
sensory information within 50'of the servant.
@@ 50
The next servant spell cast from this list will produce one servant for every
ten levels of the caster.
